acreline.title: Acreline
acreline.blurb: A WordPress theme for real estate shops. Listings, a map, agents, and showing requests — they can edit it themselves.
acreline.summary: Acreline is a WordPress theme for real estate shops. It has listings, a map, agent pages, and showing requests. I built it so a shop can set it up in WordPress without a page builder.
acreline.challenge: Real estate shops need listings, a map, and agent pages that match their land. Most ready-made themes hide the parcels and add tools offices do not use.
acreline.approach: I built a setup wizard for name, colors, and sample listings. Marketing pages use normal WordPress blocks. Brokers edit listings and agents in wp-admin. No page builder.
acreline.result: A shop can install the theme, run the wizard, and start listing properties. Hire me to brand it or load real inventory.
acreline.audience: Real estate shops and agencies that need listings, a map, and showing requests. Also hiring managers who want to see a full theme I shipped.
acreline.architecture: Sage 11 + Blade + Tailwind v4 + Vite 8. Setup wizard under Appearance → Acreline Setup. Twenty-one server-rendered Core Gutenberg blocks for marketing pages (Block Generator + Migrate to Blocks). Listings, agents, and bookings as post types (optional Acreline Core so they survive a theme switch). Native SEO tags yield to Yoast / Rank Math / SEOPress / AIOSEO. Rank Math and Yoast both score well out of the box — listings include open-graph meta and structured post types for agency directories.
acreline.handoff: You get the theme zip and a short guide. Run the setup wizard, then edit pages in WordPress. Hire me to load your listings or set the brand.

faq: Is Acreline a real estate theme?
Yes. Acreline is a WordPress real estate theme for offices that need listings, a map, agents, and showing requests — without a suburban MLS skin or Elementor stack.
Does Acreline include a setup wizard?
Yes. After you activate the theme, Appearance → Acreline Setup walks identity, color style, and optional demo content. You can skip it and use Customize anytime.
What do I get when I buy Acreline?

The marketplace pack: acreline.zip (upload in Appearance → Themes), optional child theme, Acreline Core plugin, and HTML documentation. Instant download after checkout. The theme includes the setup wizard. Hire me if you want branded installation or inventory import.
Is Acreline a live MLS or IDX theme?

No. It ships with demo inventory you manage in WordPress. Listings are a custom post type agencies edit in wp-admin. Wire a real MLS/IDX feed later — the UI does not depend on IDX chrome and the post type survives a theme switch via Acreline Core.
How does a real estate agency edit page copy?

Marketing pages use Core Gutenberg blocks with live ServerSideRender previews — your agents edit them directly in wp-admin. Listings, agents, and bookings use classic metaboxes. Brand, phone, and colors stay in Customize → Identity (or the setup wizard). No developer needed for day-to-day edits.
Can I white-label Acreline for a client real estate agency?

Yes. Theme code is GPLv2 or later. Sage / Acorn remain MIT (GPL-compatible). You can install it for a client agency, customize it, resell services on top, or fork it as a white-label base. The child theme is included for safe agency customization.
Do I need Elementor or ACF for Acreline?

No. Marketing pages use the included Gutenberg blocks. Listings and agents use metaboxes. Identity lives in the Customizer and the setup wizard. Do not install a page builder — it adds no value and conflicts with the block architecture.
Can you install or customize Acreline for my real estate office?

Yes. Buy the pack for self-serve, or Get help and I brand it, import your listings, and hand off wp-admin editing to your brokers. I can also wire a real MLS feed or build custom listing filters for your market.

walkridge.audience: Tour shops and agencies that need tours, guides, and checkout in one site. Also hiring managers who want to see a WooCommerce theme I shipped.

Yes. WalkRidge is a WordPress theme built for licensed-guide tour companies: bookable tour products in WooCommerce, guide bios, an area context page, and a contact desk — without a page builder.
Do I need WooCommerce to use WalkRidge?
WooCommerce is optional. The marketing site, blog, and contact form all run without it. You only need WooCommerce if you want to sell bookable tour products through a cart and checkout.
What do I get when I buy WalkRidge?

The marketplace pack: walkridge.zip (upload in Appearance → Themes), a child theme starter, and HTML documentation. Optional companion plugins — Walkridge Bookings and Walkridge Field Map — are sold separately. Instant download after checkout.

Go to Appearance → Customize → Identity. Brand name, phone, email, address, hours, the header CTA label and URL, and social links are all there. Upload your logo under Customize → Site Identity. No code required.

After activating the theme, go to Tools → Walkridge Blocks and click Seed pages. That creates your Tours, Guides, Area, and Contact pages with the right Gutenberg block layouts. Edit them directly in the block editor.

Yes. Buy the pack for self-serve, or get help and I brand it, load your tour inventory, and hand off wp-admin editing to your team.

tocflow.title: TOCflow
tocflow.blurb: A free WordPress plugin that builds a table of contents from post headings.
tocflow.summary: TOCflow is a small WordPress plugin. It builds a table of contents from the headings in a post. Publishers get a clean jump list without heavy scripts.
tocflow.challenge: Long posts need a jump list. Many plugins add extra blocks or hide the outline from search engines and screen readers.
tocflow.approach: I built a light plugin that reads headings and prints the list in the first page load. It stays simple. No big JavaScript kit.
tocflow.result: A publisher can add a table of contents that is easy to read and easy to find. The plugin is free. Hire me if you want it tailored.
tocflow.audience: Writers, shops, and agencies that publish long posts. Also hiring managers who want to see a small plugin I shipped.
tocflow.architecture: PHP block render callback, small editor script, optional ItemList JSON-LD. No React runtime on the front end for the list itself.
tocflow.handoff: Download the zip, turn the plugin on, and add the block. Settings are under Settings → TOCflow. Source is on GitHub if you want to fork it.
benefits: Zero config — insert the block; the outline builds itself
Server-rendered HTML for SEO and screen readers
Accurate anchors with aria-current while you read
Numbered or bulleted lists, five style presets
Shortcode for classic content
Free forever — GPLv2 or later
faq: Is TOCflow really free?
Yes. $0 checkout captures your email for update notices if you want them, or download from GitHub Releases. No freemium lock.
Does it work with classic editor posts?
Yes — use the [tocflow] shortcode. Heading anchors still inject on the front end.
Will it slow my site?
The list is in the first HTML response. Front-end JS is optional for sticky/scroll-spy and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Can you customize it for my theme?
Yes. Get help for sticky-header offsets, style presets that match your brand, or a private fork.
tocflow.brand_tagline: One block. An accessible outline from your headings.
